AccountResponse.description: Ledger account state and materialised balance

accountNumber.description: Human account number with ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 check digits

availableBalance.description: Ledger balance minus active holds: what a transfer or a new hold may use

ledgerBalance.description: Ledger balance: the sum of the account's postings, rounded HALF_EVEN

ownerOrganizationId.description: The customer organisation that owns the account (ADR 0018); null for system accounts

ApprovalListResponse.description: Approval requests in one status, oldest first

ApprovalResponse.description: A four-eyes approval request (ADR 0021): who asked, who decided, and the entry it posted

decidedBy.description: The checker; null while pending and for an expired request

postedEntryId.description: The journal entry the approval posted

CaptureHoldRequest.description: Capture a hold, fully or in part. A hold is captured at most once; the rest is released.

amount.description: Amount to capture in the hold's charge currency; omitted means the full amount

disbursementAmount.description: The part of the captured amount that is duties and taxes collected for the customs authority, in the charge currency: credited to CUSTOMS_DISBURSEMENTS, not FREIGHT_REVENUE (ADR 0036). Omitted means none

CreateAccountRequest.description: Request to open a customer ledger account in a supported ISO 4217 currency

organizationId.description: The owning organisation. A customer leaves it out (or gives its own): the account belongs to the organisation in its token. An operator must give it.

CreateApprovalRequest.description: A deposit, reversal or rate confirmation for a second operator to approve (ADR 0021). A DEPOSIT names account, amount, currency and reference; a REVERSAL names journalEntryId and, optionally, reason; a RATE_CONFIRMATION names referenceRateId and reason.

account.description: DEPOSIT: the customer account, by id or account number

amount.description: DEPOSIT: positive amount in the currency's minor units

currency.description: DEPOSIT: ISO 4217 code matching the account

reference.description: DEPOSIT: audit reference, such as the bank statement line

referenceRateId.description: RATE_CONFIRMATION: the quarantined reference rate to make usable (ADR 0034); reason is required with it

CreateHoldRequest.description: Reserve funds on a customer account for a charge that is captured later

amount.description: Amount to reserve, in the charge currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 charge currency. If it differs from the payer account's, banking converts at its own rate and locks that rate on the hold

expiresAt.description: When the hold lapses if not captured; default 7 days, at most 30

onBehalfOfSubject.description: Who booked, as logistics knows them: recorded on the hold (ADR 0020)

payerAccount.description: Payer account number (MOD 97-10 check digits) or UUID

payerOrganizationId.description: The organisation logistics charges for: the payer account must belong to it, or the account is not found (ADR 0018)

CreateTransferRequest.description: Request to transfer funds between two ledger accounts

amount.description: Transfer amount in the specified currency

fxQuoteId.description: FX quote ID (required when sourceAccount and targetAccount have different currencies)

sourceAccount.description: Source account number (with MOD 97-10 check digits) or UUID

targetAccount.description: Target account number (with MOD 97-10 check digits) or UUID

CustomsSettlementRequest.description: Pay the duties and taxes customs assessed for a captured hold to the authority (ADR 0036). The difference from the estimate captured into CUSTOMS_DISBURSEMENTS is charged to or refunded to the payer.

assessedAmount.description: Duties and import VAT as assessed, in the hold's charge currency

authorityReference.description: The authority's reference for the assessment, such as the customs declaration number

CustomsSettlementResponse.description: A customs settlement: the assessed amount paid to the authority, and the difference from the estimate charged (positive) or refunded (negative) to the payer

difference.description: assessed - estimate, in the charge currency

payerDifference.description: The difference in the payer's currency, at the hold's locked rate

DecisionRequest.description: The checker's note on a decision: optional for an approval, required for a rejection

comment.description: Why it was approved or rejected

ExtendHoldRequest.description: Move an active hold's expiry later; the amount and any locked FX rate stay as they are

expiresAt.description: The new expiry: later than the current one, at most holds.max-ttl from now and holds.max-lifetime from the hold's creation

rateSource.description: Where the rate came from (ADR 0034): ecb, ecb+cma-peg or cma-peg

rateValueDate.description: The day of the reference rate the quote is priced from

FxRatesResponse.description: Indicative exchange rates from one base currency. Not a quote: nothing is locked.

asOf.description: When the rates were read from the rate source

unavailable.description: Currencies left out because their reference rate is stale (ADR 0034); a quote or hold in them is refused with fx-rates-stale until a fresh rate is confirmed

HoldResponse.description: A hold: funds reserved on the payer account, then captured or released

amount.description: Charge amount, in the charge currency

capturedDisbursementAmount.description: The part of the capture that was duties and taxes (ADR 0036)

fxRate.description: Locked rate for a cross-currency hold: 1 payer currency = fxRate charge currency

payerAmount.description: Amount reserved on the payer account, in its currency

rateSource.description: Where the locked rate came from (ADR 0034): ecb, ecb+cma-peg or cma-peg

rateValueDate.description: The day of the reference rate the locked rate came from

InvariantReport.description: The ledger's invariants at one instant, each with the rows that break it

broken.description: The names of the broken invariants

holds.description: True when no invariant is broken

JournalEntryResponse.description: Immutable double-entry journal entry with balanced postings

actor.description: Who made the entry (ADR 0020): for a deposit or reversal, the operator who approved it. Shown to operators and auditors only

approvalId.description: The four-eyes approval that posted a deposit or reversal (ADR 0021); it names the operator who requested it. Shown to operators and auditors only

PostingResponse.description: Single signed posting within a journal entry

customerRate.description: Rate a conversion from base would use: midRate x (1 - spread)

midRate.description: Mid-market rate: 1 base = midRate quote currency

spread.description: Spread banking applies when it converts

valueDate.description: The day of the reference rate it came from

ReferenceRateResponse.description: One day's reference rate from one source: 1 base = rate quote currency

crossCheckRate.description: That source's rate for the same day: NAD per EUR for the Bank of Namibia

crossCheckSource.description: The second source it was checked against

decidedApprovalId.description: The RATE_CONFIRMATION approval that decided it

previousRate.description: The confirmed rate before it, which its day-on-day move was measured against

StatementLineResponse.description: Account statement line with running balance after the posting

actor.description: Who made the entry (ADR 0020); shown to operators and auditors only

TransferResponse.description: Executed ledger transfer and its double-entry postings
